title: ctenitis cheilanthina
intro: Ctenitis cheilanthina, commonly known as the fern of the forest floor, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis cheilanthina include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve respiratory function, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
